faq.title: Helpful Answers Before You Inquire
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about arranging residential or commercial cleaning services with Vistara in Qatar.
faq.pageDescription: Answers to common questions about our cleaning services, WhatsApp quotation process, service areas in Qatar, equipment, and scheduling.

items.question: How do I request a quotation or arrange a cleaning appointment?
items.answer: You can message us directly using any WhatsApp button on the website or complete our Get a Quote form. Once you share your service type, property type, and location in Qatar, our team communicates with you on WhatsApp to confirm scope, pricing, and appointment timing.

items.question: Is my appointment confirmed immediately when I submit the form?
items.answer: No. Submitting the form records your inquiry and prepares a WhatsApp message with your details. An appointment is only confirmed after our coordinator communicates with you on WhatsApp to finalize your requirements and schedule.

items.question: Which areas in Qatar do you cover?
items.answer: We currently serve Doha, Lusail, The Pearl-Qatar, West Bay, Al Wakrah, and Al Rayyan. If your property is nearby, feel free to message us on WhatsApp to check team availability.

items.question: How is cleaning priced?
items.answer: Quotations depend on the specific service, property size, surface conditions, and scope of work required. Sharing a brief description (and photos if helpful) on WhatsApp allows us to provide a clear, accurate quotation before scheduling.

items.question: Do your teams bring cleaning equipment and supplies?
items.answer: Yes. Our teams arrive with suitable cleaning tools, microfiber cloths, vacuums, and specialized equipment such as upholstery extractors or steam units depending on the requested service. If you prefer specific products to be used on delicate surfaces, let us know during consultation.

items.question: Can I schedule commercial or residential cleaning at flexible times?
items.answer: Yes. We coordinate visit timings around household routines or commercial operating hours, subject to availability confirmed during your WhatsApp discussion.

items.question: How should I prepare my property before the team arrives?
items.answer: For general and deep cleaning, clearing personal valuables and fragile clutter helps the team work thoroughly. For specialized services like sofa, carpet, or water tank cleaning, our coordinator will let you know any simple preparation steps in advance.

items.question: Do you offer Arabic and English customer support on WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes, our customer communication supports both English and Arabic so you can discuss your property requirements comfortably in your preferred language.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Vistara Cleaning Services collects, stores, and handles customer inquiry information in Qatar.
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: Template Policy — Review with legal counsel before launch

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit a quotation or contact inquiry on our website, we collect the details you voluntarily provide, including your name, phone number, optional email address, service selection, property type, area in Qatar, preferred schedule, and any additional notes.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your inquiry details solely to respond to your request, prepare a tailored cleaning quotation, and coordinate cleaning service appointments with you—primarily via WhatsApp or your provided phone number.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage & Security
sections.body: Inquiry records are stored securely in our server-side PostgreSQL database. We do not sell, rent, or trade customer contact details to third parties.

sections.heading: 4. WhatsApp Communication
sections.body: Clicking a WhatsApp button opens a direct WhatsApp chat initiated by you. Communications within WhatsApp are subject to WhatsApp's own terms and privacy practices.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights & Contact
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your inquiry details by contacting us using the placeholder email or WhatsApp channel listed on our Contact page.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: Terms governing website use, cleaning service quotations, and appointment arrangements in Qatar.
terms.lastUpdated: Last updated: Template Terms — Review with legal counsel before launch

sections.heading: 1. Quotations & Appointment Confirmation
sections.body: Submitting a quotation form or WhatsApp inquiry does not constitute an automatically confirmed booking. All service scopes, pricing quotations, dates, and arrival windows are finalized only after direct confirmation with our service coordinator.

sections.heading: 2. Scope of Services
sections.body: Services are performed in accordance with the scope agreed during consultation. Specialized surface, fabric, or water tank work may require inspection or additional disclosures regarding delicate materials.

sections.heading: 3. Access, Water & Power
sections.body: The client ensures safe property access, running water, and electricity during the scheduled service window, as well as secure storage of valuables and fragile items.

sections.heading: 4. Rescheduling & Cancellations
sections.body: If you need to reschedule or cancel an arranged visit, please notify our team via WhatsApp as early as possible so schedules can be adjusted.

sections.heading: 5. Placeholder Business Information
sections.body: Contact details, registration references, and hours displayed on this website include editable placeholders to be finalized by the operating company.
